issues.title: Order total is off by a cent on some orders
issues.body: `orders/total.py` sums floats and rounds with `round`, so 3 × 0.35 gives 1.05 on one order and 1.04 on another. Done when the total rounds half up, in Decimal.

issues.title: Export the orders of a month as CSV
issues.body: The shop owner needs the orders of a month as a CSV file: order, customer, total.

issues.title: Dark mode for the admin pages
issues.body: The admin pages have only a light theme.

issues.title: billing: docstring of vat says cents, but it returns euros
issues.body:
`billing/tax.py:4`: the docstring of `vat` says that it returns the VAT "in cents". The function returns euros, as a `Decimal` quantized to `0.01`. Its only caller, `get_invoice_total` in `billing/invoice.py:5`, adds the result to an order total in euros.

A reader who trusts the docstring can divide the result by 100, or multiply a euro amount by 100 before the call. The docstring must say euros.

Out of scope for #14: found by the review of the branch for #14, which changes only the `orders` module.

issues.title: accounts: sign_up treats emails that differ only in case as two accounts
issues.body:
`accounts/signup.py:4`: `sign_up` stores the email as typed and checks for duplicates with an exact match. So `Bob@shop.test` and `bob@shop.test` sign up as two accounts.

To decide: normalize the email before the check and the store (for example `strip()` and lowercase the domain or the whole address), and say how existing accounts that differ only in case are handled.

Out of scope for #14: found by the review of the branch for #14, which changes only the `orders` module.
